name: Consensus Assessment Initiative Questionnaire
description: Vendor self-assessment questionnaire for CCM v3.0.1. 309 questions across all 133 CCM v3.0.1 controls. Published 2020-04-01 as the successor to CAIQ v3.0.1 (see CSA's 'Transition to CAIQ v3.1'). The last questionnaire of the v3 line; CAIQ v4 followed in 2021 against the rebuilt CCM v4.
relationToCloudSecurity: Superseded STAR Registry questionnaire, retained because CCM v3.0.1 assessments and certifications reference it.
relationToAISecurity: None; predates AICM and the AI-CAIQ.

license.notes: CSA publications are typically released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Confirm specific document license on download page.

current_extraction.tool: build_json.py in this directory, reading CAIQ_v3.1_Final.xlsx
current_extraction.notes: Parsed from the archived xlsx. The sheet has a three-row merged header and SPARSE rows -- only the first question of each control carries the control-level columns -- so the parser forward-fills and asserts its expected headers before parsing. 309 questions, 133 parent controls, 35 mapping targets, 0 orphans.

notes: CAIQ v3.1 is the questionnaire for CCM v3.0.1, not for a CCM v3.1 -- no such CCM release exists.
Its question set covers exactly CCM v3.0.1's 133 controls, with no controls missing and no questions orphaned.

Its mapping section is NOT a superset of CCM v3.0.1's. It adds five frameworks published after 2014 (CIS-AWS-Foundations v1.1, HITRUST CSF v8.1, NZISM v2.5, PCI DSS v3.2, Shared Assessments 2017 AUP) and DROPS two that CCM v3.0.1 carries (the 95/46/EC EU Data Protection Directive, superseded by GDPR, and the CCM v1.x lineage mapping). A consumer wanting every v3-era mapping must union both files.
Three frameworks appear under different header spellings in the two files: AICPA TSC 2009/2014 and HIPAA/HITECH, which CAIQ v3.1 labels 'Omnibus Rule'. Same frameworks, different labels.

The CSA Enterprise Architecture and ODCA UM: PA R2.0 mappings are COMPOSITES spanning several columns each, stored as nested objects. Reading their sub-columns as separate frameworks is the defect that had to be corrected in ccm/3.0.1 -- see that directory's README.
Columns 22-24 (Yes/No/Not Applicable) and 25 (Notes) are a blank vendor-response template and are not extracted.

desired_end_state.notes: Pending CCM 4.1 stabilization (companion CAIQ ships with the parent CCM mappings).
